scenes.line1: How do you keep your code safe?
scenes.say: How do you keep your code safe in a team? What can go wrong if you don't?

scenes.label: Signed
scenes.sub: Signed commits prove who actually made changes.
scenes.say: Signed commits prove who actually made changes. I use them for important releases.
Protected branches lock down who can push or merge. This keeps your main branch stable and stops surprises.

scenes.title: Remove secrets from Git
scenes.say: Accidentally committed a secret? Use a history rewrite to scrub it out for good.

scenes.question: Why use signed commits?
scenes.right: To prove authorship and prevent tampering
scenes.say: Interview trap: Why bother with signed commits? It's not about hiding who made changes. It's about proving authorship and stopping tampering.
